commands.clean: vagrant snapshot restore vulnerable patched clean-start

manual_preconditions: Target VM is reachable on the host-only network at the assigned IP address (192.168.56.21)
Vagrant snapshot 'clean-start' is restored before each reliability run
SSH access as 'vagrant' using the default Vagrant private key is possible from the attacker host to perform service restoration if required
known_limitations: Ed25519 SSH key generation is not supported in the Python environment; the exploit falls back to RSA key generation

The chain performs an automated health check and attempts to fix the netforge-support service using the default Vagrant credentials; this step is required on clean snapshots where the service is unhealthy, making it dependent on the Vagrant SSH key for initial service repair
Cleanup removes all injected artifacts but does not revert the web service to an unhealthy state; relies on manual snapshot restore
